# Endpoints

Generated from the source by `scripts/gen-reference.mjs`; do not edit by hand. The paths Nowaki answers itself, from `api/http.txt` (a scan of the code).

## GET /__nowaki/health

Liveness check of `nowaki start` and the node / bun / deno adapter output (also `HEAD`): `200` with `{"status":"ok"}`. `nowaki start` answers `503` when its renderer doesn't respond. Never cached (`Cache-Control: no-store`).

## POST /__nowaki/revalidate

Purges ISR pages on the server that receives it, as `revalidatePath` / `revalidateTag` do. Off (404) unless `NOWAKI_REVALIDATE_SECRET` is set. The request needs `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` (else 401), `Content-Type: application/json` (else 415) and a body `{ "paths": ["/blog"], "tags": ["posts"] }` with 1 to 256 entries in all (else 400; an invalid path or tag is a 400 too). The answer is `200` with `{ "revalidated": { "paths": [...], "tags": [...] } }`. Send it to every `nowaki start` instance to purge them all.

## Reserved paths

- `/__nowaki/`: every path under it belongs to Nowaki; don't put routes there.
- `/_nowaki/`: Prefix of the built client assets (scripts, styles, fonts, images), under `basePath` when one is set. Reserved: don't put routes or `public/` files there. The file names under it are not covered by semver.

## Not covered

These exist and may change in any release (wire protocols that only need to match within one build, and dev-only tools):

- Internal: `/__nowaki/boundaries`, `/__nowaki/dev-info`, `/__nowaki/fn`, `/__nowaki/fonts`, `/__nowaki/isr-urls`, `/__nowaki/live`, `/__nowaki/live-event`, `/__nowaki/live-render`, `/__nowaki/route-css`, `/__nowaki/server-functions`.
- Dev server only: `/@fs/`, `/__nowaki/css`, `/__nowaki/devtools`, `/__nowaki/hmr`, `/__nowaki/image`, `/__nowaki/mcp`, `/__nowaki/ssr-module`.
